short_description: Compact 400 W electrosurgical unit for cutting, coagulation and bipolar procedures.
technical_specifications:
MAESTRO
OVERVIEW

The MAESTRO  delivers 400W Power Max with 2 monopolar outputs, 1 bipolar, B for versatile surgical use. Featuring 99 programmable settings, a 5″ touch screen, and Endo Cut mode, it ensures precision and ease of operation.

APPLICATION

MAESTRO  have clinical applications in various surgeries (Plastic, Neuro, Opthal, Laparo Surgery, Ortho, Open & General Surgery, Onco, Gynecology, Hernia, Papillotomy, Polypectomy, Under Water, Urology, Gynec TCRE, Thoracic).

FEATURES

TFT SCREEN WITH TOUCH CONTROL
ARM CORE PROCESSOR

INTIUTIVE BIPOLAR

TIME OUT FUNCTION (OPTIONAL)
FOOT SWITCHES / PEDALS
USER PROGRAMMABLE
RANDOMISED SPRAY COAG

ENDO CUT MODE

Additional information from medilap_first.pdf, page 5:
Catalogue specifications: 4 monopolar cut modes; 4 monopolar coagulation modes; 4 bipolar cut/coagulation modes; maximum output 400 W; CQM technology; instant tissue feedback technology.

product_name_source: Microprocessor-based neonatal radiant warmer with servo and manual temperature control.
short_description: Microprocessor-based neonatal radiant warmer with servo and manual temperature control.
technical_specifications:
MEDILAP MRW-02+ Infant Radiant Warmer

Microprocessor-based neonatal radiant warmer with servo and manual temperature control.

Common MRW series information from the manufacturer:
The MEDILAP MRW Infant Radiant Warmer ensures safe and precise thermal management for newborns in NICU and maternity units. Featuring microprocessor-based servo control and manual mode, it provides accurate temperature regulation and flexible operation. The bright LCD/LED display shows all vital parameters, while audio-visual alarms, key lock, and an APGAR timer enhance safety. A tilting bed, collapsible acrylic walls, and integrated X-ray tray offer easy access and monitoring. Designed for durability and efficiency, it can be seamlessly integrated with phototherapy units for complete neonatal care.

The official page lists this configuration but does not publish separate model-specific specifications.

Additional information from medilap_first.pdf, page 4:
Additional MRW-02+ specifications: servo and manual temperature control; set temperature 24-38 °C in 0.1 °C increments; patient-temperature accuracy ±0.3 °C; 650 W heater; skin sensor; LED observation light; optional procedure light approximately 2000 lux; 230 V AC, 50 Hz input; optional UPS approximately 15 minutes at 410 W load; IEC 60601 compliance; optional integrated weighing scale.

product_name_source: Neonatal phototherapy for management of hyperbilirubinemia. Single-surface overhead blue LED neonatal phototherapy unit.
short_description: Neonatal phototherapy for management of hyperbilirubinemia. Single-surface overhead blue LED neonatal phototherapy unit.
technical_specifications:
MEDIRAY 05+ Phototherapy Unit
Model: MEDIRAY-05+

MEDIRAY 05+ Phototherapy Unit

The system is engineered for high compatibility with a wide range of hospital bassinets, cribs, infant warmers, and incubators, enabling quick positioning and stable installation without modification to existing NICU infrastructure. Its optimized optical design ensures uniform light distribution across the treatment area, allowing effective phototherapy without obstructing patient access.

MEDIRAY supports continuous, uninterrupted phototherapy, while permitting real-time patient monitoring, routine nursing care, and concurrent medical interventions. The non-contact, low-heat LED system minimizes thermal stress and reduces the need for repositioning, making it highly efficient for use in high-acuity neonatal environments where safety, consistency, and workflow efficiency are critical.

Key Features & Benefits

High-intensity blue LED phototherapy for effective bilirubin reduction

Uniform light distribution across the treatment area

Low heat emission minimizes thermal stress on neonates

Enables continuous phototherapy without interruption

Unobstructed access for monitoring, nursing care, and medical procedures

Fanless, silent operation ideal for NICU environments

Energy-efficient LEDs with long operational life

Clinical Compatibility

Compatible with hospital bassinets, cribs, infant warmers, and incubators

Flexible placement without modification to existing NICU infrastructure

Suitable for high-acuity neonatal environments

Technical Specifications

Intended application: Neonatal phototherapy for management of hyperbilirubinemia

Light source: High-intensity blue LED array

Effective wavelength range: 430–490 nm

Irradiance output: ≥ 30 µW/cm²/nm

Operating mode: Continuous phototherapy

Heat emission: Low heat, non-contact operation

Acoustic noise: Silent operation with fanless design

UV radiation: Absent

IR radiation: Absent

LED operational life: ≥ 20,000 hours

Power supply: AC mains

Energy consumption: Low power consumption

Safety & Reliability

Designed for prolonged neonatal exposure

No UV or IR radiation

Supports safe use with standard neonatal eye protection

Minimal maintenance; no lamp replacement required

“Designed for efficiency, safety, and seamless integration in modern neonatal care”.

Additional catalogue information: single-surface phototherapy configuration with 4.3-inch touchscreen, high-intensity LED source, adjustable intensity with digital irradiance display, low heat emission, height and tilt adjustment, audio-visual monitoring alarms and optional compatibility with warmers, bassinets and incubators.

product_name_source: Compact syringe infusion pump for neonatal, paediatric and adult patients.
short_description: User-friendly syringe pump supporting 5 ml to 50 ml syringes with advanced infusion safety functions.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 5-50 ml; anti-bolus mechanism; pressure limit control up to 900 mmHg; KVO mode; power consumption 7 W; weight 1.75 kg; corner status LED visible from 30 feet; IPX4 protection; multiple porting.
detailed_description:
SYRU 4004 Basic is a compact syringe infusion pump for neonatal, paediatric and adult use. It supports 5 ml to 50 ml syringes and multiple-port configurations for easier transport and setup across care settings.

Safety and operating features include an anti-bolus mechanism, adjustable pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, Keep Vein Open mode after infusion, corner LED status indication visible from long range, quick start, high accuracy, safety alarms, an easy-carry handle and robust construction. The catalogue specifies 7 W power consumption, 1.75 kg weight and IPX4 protection.

product_name_source: Advanced compact syringe pump with dynamic pressure monitoring.
short_description: Advanced 5-50 ml syringe pump with dynamic pressure display, anti-bolus protection and KVO mode.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 5-50 ml; anti-bolus mechanism; pressure control up to 900 mmHg; dynamic running-pressure display with occlusion bar indicator; KVO mode; 7 W power consumption; IPX4; corner LED; multiple porting.
detailed_description:
SYRU 4004 Advance expands the 4004 platform with a dynamic running-pressure display and bar indication for occlusion monitoring. It accepts 5 ml to 50 ml syringes for neonatal, paediatric and adult infusion.

The pump includes anti-bolus protection, pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, KVO after infusion, multiple porting, long-distance corner LED status indication, quick start, prime-on-the-go controls, alarms, an easy-carry handle and a robust IPX4-protected enclosure. Power consumption is listed as 7 W.

product_name_source: Multipurpose syringe infusion pump with dose-rate functions and neonatal syringe support.
short_description: Multipurpose syringe pump supporting 2-50 ml syringes, drug-dose operation and patient-controlled analgesia.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 2-50 ml; minimum flow rate from 0.01 ml/hr; IPX4 water resistance; dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar; anti-bolus; pressure limit up to 900 mmHg; KVO; approximately 7 W power consumption; RS232 connectivity; PCA and drug-library functions.
detailed_description:
Terumax Rx is a multipurpose syringe pump designed for critical care, neonatal and anaesthetic applications. Its 2 ml syringe compatibility and flow rates beginning at 0.01 ml/hr support low-volume infusion. Drug-dose operation uses patient weight, drug concentration and dosage inputs, and the product supports patient-controlled analgesia.

The pump provides long-view LED and detailed LCD information, RS232 connectivity, anti-bolus and KVO functions, pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, and dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar. The enclosure is IPX4 water resistant and made from rugged ABS plastic designed to withstand drops.

product_name_source: Advanced syringe pump with drug library and wireless upgrade support.
short_description: Advanced syringe pump with a 2,000-drug library, dynamic pressure display and low-light status LEDs.
technical_specifications: Drug library: approximately 2,000 drugs with multiple dose units; Wi-Fi upgradable; dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar; 3.1-inch LCD and seven-segment display; strip and corner LEDs; purge and automatic bolus; post-occlusion bolus reduction; IPX4; 10 programming modes.
detailed_description:
SYRU 6006 is an advanced syringe pump with a drug library for approximately 2,000 drugs and dose units including mg, mcg, ng, cal and kcal. A violet vasopressor LED helps reduce high-risk drug identification errors.

Its 3.1-inch LCD, seven-segment display, strip LEDs and long-distance corner LED support visibility in dark ICUs. The pump offers purge bolus, hands-free automatic bolus, an adjustable maximum bolus limit, post-occlusion bolus reduction, dynamic pressure display, Wi-Fi upgrade capability, multiple porting, long battery operation, IPX4 protection and ten programming modes.

product_name_source: Premium compact syringe pump with colour display and multi-parameter layout.
short_description: Compact 1.65 kg syringe pump with a 2.4-inch colour display, Wi-Fi upgrade capability and ten programming modes.
technical_specifications: Weight: 1.65 kg; display: 2.4-inch bright TFT colour; simultaneous display of syringe size, rate, infused volume, remaining time and mode; Wi-Fi upgradable; vasopressor LED; dynamic pressure display; strip LED; IPX4; 10 programming modes.
detailed_description:
SYRU 8008 combines a compact 1.65 kg body with a 2.4-inch bright TFT colour display. Its multi-parameter layout shows syringe size, set rate, infused volume, remaining time and operating mode without screen switching.

The model includes a colour-coded violet vasopressor alert, Wi-Fi upgrade capability, dynamic running-pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar, strip LED visibility, safety alarms, long battery operation, IPX4 protection and ten programming modes.

product_name_source: Volumetric infusion pump for adult and paediatric infusion using multiple IV-set types.
short_description: Wi-Fi-enabled volumetric infusion pump with external drop sensor and adult/micro IV-set compatibility.
technical_specifications: Adult and paediatric modes; compatible with adult and micro IV sets; external drop sensor; rate entry in drops/min or ml/hr; quick ml/hr setting; Wi-Fi enabled; standby mode; IPX4; intuitive LCD/LED interface.
detailed_description:
Infumax 5005 is a volumetric infusion pump designed for adult and paediatric infusions. Its external drop sensor supports accuracy across different IV-set brands, while adult and micro IV-set compatibility broadens clinical use.

The flow rate can be entered in drops per minute or ml/hr, with a quick ml/hr setting for emergencies. The interface combines organised controls, LED indicators and an LCD. Other listed features include Wi-Fi, standby mode, quick start, high accuracy, an easy-carry handle, robust construction and IPX4 protection.

product_name_source: Open-system blood and IV-fluid warmer for operating theatre and emergency use.
product_name_search: WARMJET IV Blood and Fluid Warmer
short_description: DC-powered open-system fluid warmer supporting standard IV sets and warming rates up to 6 L/hr.
technical_specifications: Pure low-voltage DC heater; precision heat exchanger covering up to 70% of IV tubing; open-system compatibility with standard IV sets; smart idle mode; warms fluids up to 6 L/hr; Celsius/Fahrenheit display; shock-resistant portable design.
detailed_description:
WARMJET IV is a blood and fluid warmer designed for operating-theatre and emergency use. Its low-voltage DC heater removes AC power from the bedside heating circuit. A precision heat exchanger covers up to 70% of the IV tube to help limit temperature loss from airflow and ambient conditions.

The open system can be used with standard IV sets rather than dedicated consumables. Smart Idle Mode detects when therapy has not started after setup and alerts staff. The catalogue lists fluid warming up to 6 L/hr, Celsius/Fahrenheit display, a lightweight portable body and shock-resistant construction.

product_name_source: Compact ICU fluid warmer with optional secondary heating path.
product_name_search: WARMJET II Plus Blood and Fluid Warmer
short_description: Palm-sized fluid warmer for low-flow ICU infusion with universal IV-set compatibility and optional dual heating.
technical_specifications: Universal heat exchanger for major IV-set brands; door-open alarm with automatic therapy stop; pole-clamp or lanyard mounting; dedicated heating zones for small and medium IV sets; optional secondary heater; warms fluid up to 3 L/hr; smart idle mode; robust hinge.
detailed_description:
WARMJET II Plus is a compact blood and fluid warmer intended for ICU and prolonged low-flow infusion. Its universal heat exchanger is designed for major IV-set brands used in Indian hospitals. A door-style loading mechanism enables quick setup, while the door-open alarm stops therapy and alerts staff if the door is unsecured.

Pole-clamp and lanyard mounting support crowded ICU spaces. Dedicated heating paths accommodate small and medium IV sets, and an optional secondary heater provides dual heating for faster warm-up and improved temperature consistency. The catalogue lists warming up to 3 L/hr, Smart Idle Mode and a palm-sized, robust-hinge design.

short_description: Portable DVT-prevention pump delivering controlled uniform calf compression with multilingual guidance.
technical_specifications: Uniform intermittent compression; 22+ regional languages; up to 24 hours continuous therapy; automatic AKAS garment detection; all-angle display; visual/audio alarms; quiet operation; compatible thigh, calf and foot garments.
detailed_description:
HELLO 111 is a pneumatic compression device intended to support blood flow and reduce DVT risk during immobility and recovery. It delivers uniform intermittent compression to the back of the calf at constant pressure.

The system provides guidance in more than 22 regional languages, up to 24 hours of continuous therapy, automatic detection of compatible AKAS garments, an all-angle display, quiet operation and visual/audio alerts. Compatible garments include thigh, calf and foot options in multiple sizes.

technical_specifications: Three-chamber sequential compression; 22+ regional languages; up to 24 hours continuous therapy; automatic AKAS garment detection; all-angle display; alarms; quiet operation; compatible thigh, calf and foot garments.
detailed_description:
HELLO 123 is a pneumatic compression device using three chambers that inflate sequentially to gently move blood upward through the leg. Its wrap-around garment design provides consistent support during DVT-prevention therapy.

The system supports more than 22 regional languages, up to 24 hours of therapy away from plug points, automatic detection of compatible AKAS garments, an all-angle display, quiet operation and alarms. Garment choices include thigh, calf and foot variants in multiple sizes.

technical_specifications: Li-Po 7.4 V, 500 mAh battery; up to 12 hours backup; compact lightweight design; rechargeable; lock function; straightforward priming; visual/audio alarms for occlusion, syringe near end, disengagement, low/depleted battery and malfunction.
detailed_description:
Mobifusion is a portable syringe pump designed to infuse iron-chelating agents for thalassemia therapy while allowing patients to continue day-to-day activities. Its programmable interface and straightforward priming procedure are intended for home and ambulatory use.

The pump uses a 7.4 V 500 mAh lithium-polymer battery with up to 12 hours of backup. A secure lock helps protect the infusion process. Visual and audio alarms cover occlusion, syringe-near-end, syringe disengagement, low battery, depleted battery and device malfunction.

SYRU 1947 is part of AKAS's Elixir Vitae infusion platform, designed around precise infusion and simplified controls. The system supports stacking of up to six pumps and multiple porting for flexible transport, rapid setup and transitions across care settings.

detailed_description:
Uromon continuously monitors urine output and supports fluid-balance assessment in critical-care patients. Fifteen-minute resolution is intended for close monitoring after liver or kidney transplantation and other ICU situations.

An attached printer allows urine-output history to be placed in the patient file. The system includes a bag-level indicator, bag-disturbance alerts, bar-graph display and software data sets for oliguria and acute kidney injury based on urine output in ml/kg/hr.

technical_specifications:
Venturi Mask Multi Dial
Product Code No: 4062
The venturi mask, also known as an air-entrainment mask, is a medical device to deliver
a known oxygen concentration to patients on controlled oxygen therapy. Venturi masks
are considered high-flow oxygen therapy devices. This is because venturi masks are
able to provide total inspiratory flow at a specified F102 to patients therapy. The kits
usually include multiple jets in order to set the desired FIO2 which are usually color
coded. The color of the device reflects the delivered oxygen concentration, for
example: blue = 24%; yellow = 28%; white = 31%; green = 35%; pink = 40%;
orange = 50%. The color however varies with different brands and the user must check
the instructions to determine the correct color for the desired FIO2. (The colours and
respective delivery concentrations are; Blue 24%, White 28%, Yellow 35%, Red 40%,
Green 60%). This system is often used with air-entrainment nebulizers to provide
humidification and oxygen therapy.
Available in 2 sizes : Adult/Child.

the top of the bellows. Use of the catheter holder enables the vacuum to be controlled to a maximum of 190mm of Hg. If the
aperture is closed merely by holding a finger on it, the maximum vacuum possible is raised to 400mm of Hg. Capacity of the
jar is 500ml, made up of polycarbonate is unbreakable, & autoclavable. Frame is made up of M.S. with powder coated for a
long life span.
